newsitem.title: JAPAN: Seiyu 6-mth current profit seen up 72 pct--paper.
newsitem.headline: Seiyu 6-mth current profit seen up 72 pct--paper.

text.p: Supermarket chain operator Seiyu Ltd is expected to post parent current profit of 5.7 billion yen for the six months to August 31, 1996, up 72 percent from a year earlier, due to restructuring efforts including a cut in labour costs, a newspaper said on Friday.

The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said, however, that its figure was smaller than the company's own forecast of six billion yen. Clothing sales in summer had been poor due to bad weather, the paper said.
A Seiyu spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the report.
